name: TreeBench
intro: TreeBench是一个诊断性基准测试，旨在评估多模态AI模型在视觉基础推理方面的能力。它基于三个原则构建：复杂场景中细微目标的视觉感知、通过边界框评估的可追溯证据以及超越简单目标定位的二阶推理。该基准包含405个具有挑战性的视觉问答对，即使是最先进的模型也难以达到60%的准确率。
org: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Byt
build_method: 人工标注, 专家构建, 混合
intro_en: TreeBench is a diagnostic benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal AI models' capabilities in visual fundamental reasoning. It is built on three principles: visual perception of subtle objects in complex scenes, traceable evidence assessed through bounding boxes, and second-order reasoning beyond simple object localization. The benchmark includes 405 challenging visual question-answer pairs, with even state-of-the-art models struggling to achieve 60% accuracy.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with TreeBench arXiv:2507.07999, Section 3; official Haochen-Wang409/TreeVGR and TreeBench dataset repositories. TreeBench begins with 1,000 dense-object images sampled from SA-1B across ten categories. Eight LMM experts first screen category fit and image quality, retaining 647 images. OpenAI o3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro each propose three questions per image under perception and reasoning protocols. Human experts select, edit, or replace these proposals, write answer options and evidence bounding boxes, and remove items solved by all four strong VLM filters. Independent cross-validation yields 405 visual question-answer pairs covering ten competencies. Models must provide a multiple-choice answer and traceable evidence boxes; answer accuracy measures task correctness while mean IoU measures evidence localization quality, with perception and second-order reasoning results reported separately.
